title: Just Noticeable Difference
text: Formally, Just Noticeable Difference (JND) can be defined as the magnitude of change in a stimulus necessary for it to be perceived as different from another stimulus, or as the smallest detectable difference between two stimuli (Stern and Johnson 2010).
